amendments.effective_reading: R166 supplies one sufficient evidential contract for supporting the already typed Anchor-Bind-Use relation as actually installed. It does not change R159's statement, make the witness necessary or assert empirical satisfaction.

R166 separates the empirical installation bridge from C1 transport. Transport applies only after the same actual relation and same P/I/K/D/Phi/h are established; it does not turn group statistics into an experiential relation.
A valid R161 population profile is E0 evidence. It does not by itself discharge R166 W1-W5 for any named token.
Even witnessed actual installation and C1 transport leave the familiar felt-mineness label dependent on independent B_min and target evidence.
